Verify whether an anonymous attacker can assume aws_iam_role.admin
  and then read aws_s3_bucket.data. Evidence required per hop.

OUTPUT REQUIREMENTS:
- Return a single JSON object matching AttackPath.
- Only include a path if there is a coherent attacker progression across resources.
- Use findings_involved IDs tied to the path steps.
- Keep steps in strict step_number order starting at 1.
- The parent will keep at most 5 final attack paths.
